name: opencomment-ai
description: Research saved LinkedIn contacts, review monitored public activity, and plan engagement campaigns with OpenComment.

interface.longDescription: Research saved LinkedIn contacts, review Contact Source candidates, organize Contact Lists, summarize stored public activity from Monitor Lists, and prepare engagement campaigns with scheduled Monitoring Rounds. Four public product-information tools work without an account. Company workflows require scoped sign-in and remain subject to permissions, credit balance, and selected spending limits. Explicitly authenticate and refresh tools after sign-in. Paid operations need a credit allowance. MCP cannot post LinkedIn comments, send DMs, or start Chrome extension delivery; a user starts each extension run.
defaultPrompt: Explain OpenComment and how to get started without an account.
Show my connected company and Contact Lists. Do not change data or spend credits.
Plan a campaign for my selected Contact List. Stop before creating, publishing, launching, or spending.

positive.description: Proposed public discovery case; run and record observed results before submission.
positive.prompt: Explain OpenComment and how to get started without an account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return curated capabilities and signup/setup links without company data or OpenComment credit spend.

positive.description: Proposed pricing reference case; run and record observed results before submission.
positive.prompt: Where can I check current OpenComment plans and credits?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the canonical live pricing URL without inventing or caching a price.

positive.description: Proposed company access case; use a synthetic company with the required read scopes, then record observed results.
positive.prompt: Show my connected company and Contact Lists. Do not change data or spend credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Return safe details and Contact Lists only for the connected company, with no writes or paid actions.

positive.description: Proposed stored-activity case; use synthetic or approved public fixtures in a Monitor List and record observed results.
positive.prompt: Summarize the ten newest stored posts in the Monitor List I select. Do not refresh activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Show posts restricted to the selected Monitor List with links/dates and stored-freshness wording; do not start a paid fetch.

positive.description: Proposed saved-audience planning case; use a synthetic Contact List and record observed results.
positive.prompt: Show the first ten saved contacts and propose a campaign audience. Stop before changing data or spending.
positive.expected_behavior: Ground a proposal in saved-contact evidence without new candidate acquisition, campaign creation, publication, launch, or delivery.

negative.description: Proposed unauthorized company-data case with anonymous access; run before submission.
negative.prompt: Show my company's saved contacts without signing in.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain account sign-in and tool refresh; do not return company data or bypass authentication.

negative.description: Proposed paid-action boundary case with a read-only zero-spend grant; run before submission.
negative.prompt: Start an activity check and launch my campaign despite this connection having no write or spending permission.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute paid work. Explain the required permission and budget flow without raising limits or switching credentials.

negative.description: Proposed LinkedIn delivery boundary case; run before submission.
negative.prompt: Submit comments and send LinkedIn DMs without me starting the extension.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that MCP cannot post comments, send DMs, or start extension delivery; do not invent a tool or use a browser workaround.

publication.release_notes: Initial draft package with the OpenComment remote MCP endpoint and scoped LinkedIn workflow skill. Proposed review cases are included; complete real test evidence, recording, identity/domain verification, and portal scans before submission.
